source_comparison.method: Token comparisons preserve strings, ignore comments/whitespace/optional trailing commas and normalize family visibility, module facades, explicit private hook imports and close-mode representation. Owned maps to former true, Serialized to former false, and only the same two mode predicates are translated. All other guards, calls, cleanup/disposal/notification ordering and fixture assertions match. Review aid, not formal refinement.

limitations: Mechanical source comparisons aid review, not formal refinement.
CloseMode names execution policy; it supplies no authority, root lease, completion/quiescence proof or physical replay permission.
Existing loose local cleanup state is not made inert; containing destruction, serialized revocation and outer IRQ/guard/callback qualification remain separate.
No broader pressure/fairness, recovery custody, model change or attribution of historical scheduler/metrics/root-close/mapping failures.
Tracked boot diffs omit untracked new modules; explicit frozen Rust hashes identify the complete changed source set.
